_comment: store-kit config for Momera Recorder. Toolkit lives at
candidateCount is deliberately absent: the default is 50 per tier, which
is the target integration_test/store_screenshots.dart is written against.
_iconMaster: The square logo with its near-white ground — the same file
flutter_launcher_icons reads, so the Play icon and the launcher icon are
the same artwork. mark_color_1024.png is the same mark with the ground
knocked out to alpha; it is the adaptive foreground, not the store icon.
_locales: en leads, so en-US is the default Play listing and every other Play
language falls back to it. zh -> zh-CN and zh_Hant -> zh-TW come from the
toolkit's built-in table and are correct here.

_dwellMs: 2000 rather than the 1500 default: several screens here settle into a
waveform or a fading notice, and a short dwell caught them mid-animation.

_gradient: Explicit, not auto. The icon master is a mark on a near-white ground, so
an auto gradient sampled from its corners comes out white-on-white. These
are AppTheme.light.accent (#8B5CF6) and a deeper violet of the same hue.
featureGraphic.languageLine: English · 中文 · 日本語 · 한국어

tagline.ja: 録音して、文字起こし。すべてオフラインで。

_appstore: Present because this repo already ships an iOS target with the SAME bundle
Nothing here changes what the Play flow produces — it is read only by
apple-store-assets command drives. The app has no ads and no consent flow,
so dartDefines carries only the microphone gate.
_contentScan: Nothing to scan: this app has no bundled JSON content and no randomised
user-visible strings. Every screen's text is either from lib/l10n/*.arb or
from the recordings seeded by integration_test/store_screenshots.dart,
which are fixed literals in that file.
